tenderSchedule.title: Transportation of UHT MAP milk from Chikkaballapura Milk Union to Northern command units of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh and Eastern command units of Sikkim state
tenderSchedule.description: Tenders are invited from the registered transport companies for transportation of UHT MAP milk from Chikkaballapura Milk Union to Northern command units of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh and Eastern command units of Sikkim state. The approximate quantity to be supplied for year, The transporter need to quote the rates per liter basis only.
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Co-operative Milk Producers Federation Limited
tenderSchedule.locationName: Managing Director Chikkaballapura District Co-operative Milk Producers Union Ltd

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Earnest Money Deposit as mentioned in Annexure - A of Technical Bid and Tender processing Fee through any of the following online modes of e-Payment as mentioned in e-Procurement portal. 1. Credit Card 2. Direct Debit - ICICI Bank Account holders 3. National Electronic Fund Transfer NEFT or Real Time Gross Settlement RTGS 4. Over-the-Counter OTC remittance at ICICI Bank designated branches.

Purchasers has right to accept any bid, to reject any or all the bids.1.Tender Accepting Authority Reserves the Right to accept lowest or any tender or to assign any reason for not accepting any tender.2.The authority competent to accept the tenders shall have the right to negotiate with the successful tenderer offering the tenders by calling for their lowest rates and then to finalise the tender.3.Any item can be deleted from the lsit of tender without giving any reasons or notice.

Bidders shall submit EMD proportional to the groups selected for bid submission. The total EMD shall be calculated by bidders based on Annexure - A of Technical Bid and the same shall be entered by bidder in Variable EMD field in e-Procurement Portal prior to payment of EMD.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Transporters shall submit the copies of registration certificates of their company, GST certificate and also the IBA certificate. The Company Should possess branch office at the destination state and should upload the address proof of the concerned branch and Upload the tender documents duly Signed where ever the signature is required
